final --knob unverified_gold=true (deviation id required) reports an UNVERIFIED c17 block on model-drafted test gold beside the human-gold headline
quantize --knob heal_mix sets a later heal round's bf16/Clef target mix; refused without a deviation id; the heal log records both mixes

with --knob gating=clean, quantize's accuracy, calibration, heal trigger and agreement read only the contamination stage's clean sources; the guard is reported and a guard below stock-5 is a heal reason
quantize --knob heal_repeat repeats the heal set's domain and guard rows (deviation id and gating required)
with --knob gating=clean-report the guard is reported beside stock's and never heals or fails a format; the un-healed int4 is the shipped build
benchmark and final ask Clef with the bearer key and model header; final may run a second time only under a recorded deviation
edge may measure the shipped quant on the AGX Orin with the fit fold as its probe set and the server's real cgroup cap
